description: Interactive step-based zoom number line tool for CBSE Grade 7 Mathematics (Decimals chapter). Five steps showing progressive zoom to locate 4.185. Step 1: Number line 0-10 with segment 4-5 highlighted in Orange. Step 2: Zoom to 4-5 divided into 10 parts (each 0.1), segment 4.1-4.2 highlighted in Dark Green. Step 3: Zoom to 4.1-4.2 divided into 10 parts (each 0.01), segment 4.18-4.19 highlighted. Step 4: Zoom to 4.18-4.19 divided into 10 parts (each 0.001), mark at 4.185 with bold Orange circle. Step 5: Practice mode — student clicks segments to zoom and locate 9.876. Magnifying glass animation between zoom levels. Level labels: Ones, Tenths, Hundredths, Thousandths in Navy Blue. Each zoom is animated with smooth transition.
subject: Mathematics
topic: Zooming Into Number Lines to Locate Precise Decimals
teachingNotes: Key teaching tool for the zoom technique. Steps 1-4 demonstrate with 4.185, Step 5 enables student practice with 9.876. Each zoom reveals one more decimal digit.
instructionsForStudent: Watch how we zoom in step by step to find 4.185. Each level reveals one more digit. Then try locating 9.876 yourself!
